pages.content: Shipping policy At Kreo , we ensure a smooth shopping experience. Please review our shipping policy for details on procedures and timelines. Domestic Shipping Aspect Details Processing Time Orders are processed within 1-3 working days . Processing Days No processing is done on weekends or public holidays. Delay Notifications We will notify you of any unforeseen delays. Tracking Your Order You will receive a shipping confirmation with a tracking ID once dispatched. Track your order via your account or the link sent through WhatsApp. Damages & Lost Shipments For damaged products, contact our support team to file a claim. Keep all packaging materials for verification. Out of Stock If an item is unavailable: We will contact you within 2 business days to discuss options. Refunds for cancellations will be processed within 7 business days . Return Policy All products undergo quality checks and are guaranteed to be genuine and new . We offer a 7-day return policy for manufacturing defects or dissatisfaction. No replacements are provided except in out-of-stock situations. Conditions for Product Return Products must be in original condition with all accessories. No scratches or modifications are allowed. Non-Returnable Items Items damaged due to misuse or mishandling are not returnable. Refund Process Refunds will be processed within 7 business days after the return is received. Refunds will be issued to the original payment method . Pricing & Taxes Prices may change without notice. Orders are billed at the price at the time of purchase. All products are subject to GST as per Indian tax regulations . International Shipping We currently do not offer international shipping. For inquiries, contact our support team at help@kreo-tech.com . Thank you for shopping with Kreo-Tech!

Kreo Ikarus Wireless Gaming Mouse FLAGSHIP PIXART 3395 26000 DPI Ultimate Precision 650 IPS Tracking Speed 4000 Hz Polling Rate 100+ Hours Battery life for unmatched freedom. PixArt Motion Sync Technology This latest flagship sensor from Pixart has the highest specs in the market with extreme precision of 99.6% resolution accuracy. However, this does not mean the sensor is more accurate tracking. To make your sensor more accurate tracking, the Motion-Sync Technology is built into the sensor. Your PC extracts information from another sensor at a rate that does not perfectly match the signal the mouse sends out when it extracts information from another sensor. The Motion-Sync Technology synchronize its signals intelligently at the exact intervals your pc extracts information. This allows the tracking to be very accurate. What sensor does the Kreo Ikarus mouse use? The Ikarus is equipped with a high-performance Pixart 3395 sensor providing up to 26,000 DPI for precise tracking, 650 IPS, and 50g acceleration, ensuring zero smoothing, filtering, or acceleration for competitive gaming. What makes the Ikarus ultra-lightweight? The Ikarus weighs only 55g, making it one of the lightest wireless gaming mice available. This ultra-light design reduces hand fatigue during extended gaming sessions while maintaining precise control. What connection modes does the Ikarus support? The Ikarus offers triple connectivity with 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth, and wired USB-C connections, allowing you to seamlessly switch between devices or use it with different setups for maximum versatility. What type of switches does it use? It features high-end Omron Optical D2FP switches that offer faster activation, lower input lag, and 100M+ click lifespan, providing consistent performance and durability for competitive gaming. How long does the battery last? The Ikarus delivers 100+ hours of gameplay on a single charge with its 500mAh battery, ensuring you can game for days without interruptions or frequent charging. What polling rate does the Ikarus support? The Ikarus features an ultra-fast 4000Hz wireless polling rate, delivering lightning-fast response times that give you a competitive edge in fast-paced games. Customer Reviews Based on 51 reviews Write a review 63% (32) 18% (9) 10% (5) 2% (1) 8% (4) 81.8 87.1 R Rahul Singh Kreo Ikarus Best mouse in this price segment. Best performance while gaming. J James First the buying kreo mouse and it's 2.4ghz mode not working Disappointed that's it my first 5k mouse and defected only able to used wired r ridhul pauly Good mouse, but need more QC I recently got this mouse, it’s quite a good deal. The sensor is accurate, making it great for both gaming and productivity tasks. One of the standout features is the scroll wheel, which performs much better than the Pegasus model. The higher polling rate is also a nice touch, giving a smooth and responsive feel during use. Additionally, the design is sleek, and it feels very comfortable in hand, plus it’s super lightweight. However, there are some issues that hold it back. There is a port for the reciever below the mouse which is completely useless as it comes with a 4k dongle which doesnt fit inside this, i dont understand why would they put a space for that. The mouse could benefit from better quality control. It tends to creek when pressed on the sides, which is a bit off-putting. The scroll wheel, while generally good, can sometimes feel mushy when clicked, and there’s a noticeable play in it, making it feel slightly loose. Overall, I’d give this mouse a 3/5. The performance is solid, but the build quality could use some improvement. L Laza I LOVE IT I don’t write reviews mostly but i have to for this mouse. For past 3yrs I’ve been on the hunt for a good mouse that’s worth my money. I started gaming with the Logitech G102 wired mouse, went to G304 as it’s the same mouse but wireless and better sensor, stuck to it until i tried the Razer viper mini(got double clicking issue on both the Logitech mice so i was looking for a new one). I got hooked to the Viper mini’s shape and it’s low weight, i play fps games and my aim was getting better in Valorant and Apex Legends, hit a lot of high scores each day in Aimlabs and kovaaks. Soon the Viper mini got it’s famous scroll wheel issue and playing Apex legends with a faulty scroll wheel was hell(i bind jump on scroll wheel). Also I didn’t like the feel of scroll wheel on the Razer mouse compared with the Logitech ones. I bought the Razer Viper 8khz, felt it was big as i was used to the Viper mini but the similar shape helped me adapt to it quicker. Was gaming with it a lot, similar progress with my fps games and my aim was at it’s peak. Soon the same scroll wheel issue developed in this mouse(i did look up for some info and most Razer mouse get scroll wheel issues). I wished i had a mouse with the feel of Logitech’s scroll wheel and Razer’s shape, weight and fantastic mouse clicks. I watched yt reviews for a lot of gaming mouse and i saw the video from Kreo on Pegasus mouse, i was looking at it’s Logitech Gpro kinda looks and scroll wheel from the pictures and videos, wanted to try it but i was hesitant that it’s a new brand i never heard of and to my surprise it was from my own country lol. I kept using the Viper 8khz but frustrations built up each time i died in the games because of a failed scroll jump. Few days back i saw the Kreo ikarus video on their Yt channel and i was tempted by the looks, i mean the logitech gpro kinda scroll wheel and my Razer Viper’s shape(also i looked into the specs, top tier sensor and optical switches which is a must for me). I bought it yesterday on Amazon, received it same day and the instant i held the mouse and i felt so right, this is what i was looking for such a long time. I doubted the quality but it’s just built so good like Razer and Logitech mouses. The coating was similar to Logitech the scroll wheel felt exactly like how i wanted it to be and i did not feel any difficulties with my grip as it was close to Viper’s shape. I got the mouse setup, installed the software and adjusted settings, hopped in to Valorant. I don’t know how but i was hitting shots like never before. I know it’s the best sensor but along with the mouse shape, weight and feel i was speed running my aim duels. I cannot thank Kreo enough for making such a wonderful product. I feel bad that i did not try brands other than Razer and Logitech thinking about quality and performance issues. This mouse is on par with the Razer Viper mouses and Logitech Gpro but for half the cost. To people who are hesitant just like me thinking about quality and performance all i got to say is you will not regret buying this if you are looking for a mouse with similar shape and size. Thank you Kreo and please continue to make wonderful products. C C. One of the best products by kreo fit my hand well & the design suits my grip style , Load More

What improvements does the V2 version offer over the original? The Actus V2 features enhanced lumbar support with adjustable positioning, upgraded breathable mesh panels for better airflow, and reinforced armrest mechanisms. The seat foam is now high-resilience grade that maintains comfort longer than the original version. How does the breathable design help during intense gaming? The V2 incorporates mesh ventilation zones in the backrest and seat sides that promote airflow, preventing the heat buildup common with solid gaming chairs. This keeps you cool and comfortable during marathon gaming sessions or competitive tournaments. What's the build quality and stability like? The Actus V2 uses a reinforced steel frame with upgraded hydraulic cylinder rated for 350 lbs capacity. The five-star base features heavy-duty casters and a wider stance for enhanced stability, even during animated gaming moments. How customizable are the comfort settings? The V2 offers comprehensive adjustability including seat height, backrest angle (90-160 degrees), tilt tension, and 3D armrests. The lumbar support adjusts both vertically and horizontally, allowing you to dial in the perfect ergonomic position. What warranty and support comes with the chair? The Actus V2 includes a 5-year warranty on the gas cylinder and frame, 2 years on mechanical components, and 1 year on upholstery. Free replacement parts are available for the first year, plus lifetime customer support for assembly and adjustment questions. What gaming platforms and devices does the Mirage support? The Mirage offers universal compatibility with PC, Android, iOS, Nintendo Switch, and Steam Deck via Bluetooth 5.0 or 2.4GHz wireless connection. It seamlessly switches between devices with saved profiles for each platform, making it perfect for multi-platform gamers. How's the battery life and charging convenience? The Mirage delivers 15+ hours of continuous gaming with RGB lighting active, or 25+ hours with lighting off. The USB-C fast charging provides 4 hours of gameplay from just 15 minutes of charging, plus you can play while charging without performance impact. What makes the controls responsive for competitive gaming? Features ultra-low 1ms wireless latency, mechanical face buttons, and Hall Effect analog sticks that eliminate stick drift. The 1000Hz polling rate ensures every input registers instantly, making it suitable for competitive gaming across multiple genres. How customizable are the RGB lighting and button mapping? The Mirage offers 16.7 million color RGB zones with multiple lighting effects, all customizable through the companion app. Button remapping, trigger sensitivity, and stick deadzone adjustments let you optimize the controller for different games and playing styles. What's the build quality and comfort for extended gaming? Constructed with premium materials including textured grips and ergonomic design based on extensive hand-size research. The controller feels solid without being heavy, and the button tactility is optimized for both precision and comfort during marathon gaming sessions. Enabling wired Dinput Mode (PS4 Mode) Ensure the controller is powered off. Press and hold the Triangle (△) button. While continuing to hold the Triangle button, connect the USB cable to the controller and the console/PC. After the cable is connected, wait for 2 seconds, then release the Triangle button. The home LED will briefly illuminate in blue, indicating that wired Dinput (PS4) mode is enabled.
